extraction.name: EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification
extraction.description: A novel dataset of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced Sentinel-2 satellite image patches for land use and land cover classification, with benchmarks using deep CNNs.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images were downloaded from Sentinel-2A via Amazon S3, selecting images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas across 34 European countries. Images with low cloud level were chosen, and 64x64 georeferenced image patches were created and manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web API, Manual Human Curator, Passive Data Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset includes images with clouds, mislabeling, dead pixels, ice/snow, and atmospheric color cast; these were not filtered out in all cases, though mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were sorted out during manual checking.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open and freely accessible Sentinel-2 satellite imagery from ESA's Copernicus program, downloaded via Amazon S3, using cities covered in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Image patches were extracted from satellite images; lower-resolution bands were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation for band evaluation; RGB images were formed by combining B04, B03, and B02.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Satellite images were selected with low cloud level; 64x64 patches were created; all 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times; mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice were removed; bands with lower spatial resolution were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel for evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels were assigned to 64x64 image patches for 10 land use and land cover classes, and the ground truth was manually checked and corrected by sorting out mislabeled images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper reports manual correction of ground truth by removing mislabeled images; no uncertainty or disagreement analysis is described.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Geography (geo-referenced images; European cities across 34 countries).
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended for Earth observation applications such as land use and land cover change detection and improving geographical maps, with potential relevance to urban development, nature protection, sustainable development, and climate change monitoring.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset was intentionally collected across many European countries and throughout the year to increase intra-class variance; classes have low positive correlation, and some classes are more common to each other. No additional bias analysis is provided.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to Sentinel-2 imagery over European cities and 10 classes; it uses 64x64 patches and does not support fine-grained per-pixel segmentation. The paper notes that some images contain clouds, atmospheric color cast, dead pixels, or snow/ice, and that the dataset has not received atmospheric correction.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, benchmarking, and evaluation of land use and land cover classification models; also demonstrated for land use/land cover change detection and assistance in keeping geographical maps up to date.
